nodes.label: What's up?
nodes.content:
I'm changing pretty fast at the moment, and it's hard to update this site with everything I'm thinking about right now. In general, [you should come talk to me](https://calendly.com/jesseangrist/talkin) about any of the following:
- effective altruism, especially climate, air pollution, animal welfare, and GHD cause areas
- AI safety, AI futurism, and AI consciousness/moral patienthood
- Ethics, aesthetics, partiality, and love
- Art and poetry(!)
- Meditation, spirituality, and inner work

You can read my poetry, confessional writing, and effortposts (which can be hard to distinguish from one another) on my [Substack](https://substack.com/@jesseangrist), and you can catch me in person in Princeton, NJ (or, well, most places in the Northeast Corridor, time permitting). I'll also be at [EAGNYC, Oct. 16-18](https://www.effectivealtruism.org/ea-global/events/ea-global-new-york-city-2026) and [GCP Lite in Berkeley, Oct. 23-25!](https://www.globalchallengesproject.org/)
